turns.user_utterance: Hey, I am in the store and my card keeps getting rejected.
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when you try to pay, is the terminal showing a “declined” or “payment not approved” message, or something like “card not supported/try another card”?

turns.user_utterance: It shows “payment not approved”, like it says try another card.
turns.assistant_response: Thanks—if it says “payment not approved / try another card,” that usually means the card payment was declined. A couple quick checks: are you trying to pay in person (chip/contactless) and is the card currently enabled and not reported lost or locked? Also, did you recently make a payment/online attempt that may have caused the merchant to retry—can you tell me whether the card is being declined for every shop purchase or just this one terminal?
